spearman_ranking_correlation.comment: Direct comparison of per-type Procrustes residuals between two species pairs on the same 12 cell-type definitions; informs Figure 5C / Methods text on whether per-type divergence ranks co-vary across species pairs.

human_macaque_12type.preprocessing: Qu raw UMI → normalize_total(1e4) → log1p; 2,000 cells/type (seed 42)

no_immune_sensitivity_n7_D1.framing: Excluding the 5 immune types (B cell, macrophage, monocyte, plasma cell, neutrophil) added in K, the n=7 non-immune analysis confirms cross-species coherence at p < 0.05. Serves as the methodologically clean replacement for the committed sensitivity (RIRA-only 13-type, p=0.0002 but preprocessing-asymmetric).
no_immune_sensitivity_n7_D1.p_value_note: Canonical from (cached centroids + src/procrustes.py + seed=42) via Part 4A null_distribution_qu7_D1.npy. Supersedes earlier 0.0125 recorded in reconstruction_qu7_D1_results.json, which is not bit-reproducible from currently-committed artifacts (3/10000 permutation-count shift, same observed distance, same significance framing: clears α=0.05, not α=0.01).

hepatocyte_rank_reversal.narrative: Hepatocyte rank reversal from most-rigid (mouse) to most-flexible (macaque) confirmed and strengthened at n=12 under symmetric preprocessing.

macaque_annotation_provenance: Qu et al. 2022 author-assigned labels from Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.5881495 @meta.data (finalcluster + majorcluster + Organ); no post-hoc marker-gene re-harmonization
